newsitem.title: UK: Shield Diagnostics up on talk of "buy" note.
newsitem.headline: Shield Diagnostics up on talk of "buy" note.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics Plc rose on Wednesday after a newspaper report that a major brokerage was poised to issue a "buy" recommendation on the stock, dealers said.
Shrugging off sharp declines among many biotechnology stocks after Celltech Plc dropped development of a key drug, Shield was up 20p at 430 by 0829 GMT in volume of 44,188 shares.

Shares in the company, which has developed a test to predict a patient's likelihood of suffering a heart attack, shot to a record 928p on March 14 but subsequently more than halved in value, falling as low as 355p on May 8.
A report in the Daily Mail said a "buy" recommendation from UBS was imminent, though analysts at the investment bank declined comment.
The paper also said that directors from Shield would be appearing at a technology conference in London on Wednesday. No-one at the company was immediately available for comment.
